name: SEO Health Report
query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN IFNULL(seo_score, 0) >= 80 THEN 'Excellent' 
        WHEN IFNULL(seo_score, 0) >= 50 THEN 'Average' 
        ELSE 'Needs Improvement' 
    END as status, 
    count(*) as count 
FROM (
    SELECT seo_score FROM `tabWeb Page` WHERE published = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT seo_score FROM `tabBlog Post` WHERE published = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT seo_score FROM `tabBuilder Page` WHERE published = 1
) AS combined_seo
GROUP BY status
